obligations.source_text: Create one independently invented, complex, photorealistic test scene in which a referenced adult operates a quiet archival mechanism and each important visual element remains inspectable for later pixel qualification.

bindings.pan_tracked_core_phrase: the moving subject's identity-bearing core remains comparatively sharp and readable across her face and torso
bindings.pan_background_streak_phrase: environmental detail stretches into predominantly parallel directional streaks across the receding archive
bindings.pan_secondary_motion_phrase: secondary moving parts retain plausible local motion or rotational blur in her turning hand and loose hair
bindings.pan_vector_phrase: background streaks subject travel and local motion cues agree on one lateral movement vector from foreground rails through distant stacks
bindings.pan_boundary_phrase: comparative subject sharpness proves active tracking rather than uniform camera shake radial zoom or composited blur through coherent relative blur gradients
